title: Confront
shortDesc: Tactical combat shooter. Infiltrate hostile sectors and eliminate rival combatants in this high-intensity unblocked classic.
instructions: Navigate hostile terrain utilizing structural cover.
Engage enemy combatants with precision fire.
Clear all hostiles to secure sector advancement.

title: Happy Room
shortDesc: Physics laboratory destruction arena. Deploy kinetic traps, automated turrets, and energy weaponry to test ragdoll stress tolerance.
instructions: Install weapon hardware along laboratory test grid.
Trigger the dummy deployment to activate kinetic weapons.
Complete weapon research goals to unlock tier upgrades.

title: Happy Wheels
shortDesc: Legendary ragdoll physics obstacle course. Navigate perilous lethal gauntlets with wheeled vehicles and survivor abilities.
instructions: Balance vehicle momentum across deadly obstacle tracks.
Utilize character abilities to bypass structural traps.
Survive and cross the finish marker.

title: Gunblood
shortDesc: Western quick-draw shootout duel. Test reaction speed and lethal precision against notorious outlaws in 1v1 showdowns.

controls.action: Place cursor on gun chamber to start countdown

instructions: Keep cursor inside chamber until 'FIRE' is signaled.
React instantaneously to draw and eliminate the rival.
Survive 9 increasingly lethal rounds.

title: Age of War
shortDesc: Epic cross-era evolutionary warfare defense. Advance through 5 evolutionary eras, summon soldiers, and conquer opposing bases.

controls.action: Recruit warriors, build turrets, upgrade era

instructions: Accumulate gold and experience by defeating enemies.
Advance through eras: Stone, Castle, Renaissance, Modern, Future.
Destroy the enemy base to achieve total victory.

title: Bloons TD
shortDesc: Classic strategic balloon defense. Deploy dart monkeys, tack shooters, and super towers to burst invading waves of bloons.

controls.action: Upgrade range, attack speed, and piercing power

instructions: Position defensive towers along the track bends.
Upgrade weapons to pierce rubber, lead, and camo bloons.
Prevent bloons from escaping the course.

title: Duck.ai
shortDesc: Anonymous private search & AI interface powered by DuckDuckGo. Embedded directly inside Sonar OS.
instructions: Execute anonymous searches & AI queries inside this window.
Never leave Sonar OS while browsing.
Minimize or close window to return to desktop.

title: 2048 Protocol
shortDesc: Mathematical matrix consolidation puzzle. Merge numeric data cells to synthesize the 2048 master block.
instructions: Shift tiles across the 4x4 matrix.
Tiles with matching values merge into their sum.
Consolidate units to reach the 2048 objective.

title: Vector Snake
shortDesc: Grid-based vector navigation. Harvest energy nodes to expand segment length without perimeter breach.
instructions: Acquire red energy units to increase length.
Avoid structural boundaries and self-collision.
Optimize pathing for maximal grid coverage.

title: Galaxy Defense
shortDesc: Orbital sector interceptor defense against descending hostile armada. Protect terrestrial boundaries.
instructions: Neutralize approaching airborne invaders.
Utilize energy bunkers for kinetic shielding.
Intercept priority command cruisers for score multipliers.

title: Breakout Grid
shortDesc: Kinetic deflection matrix. Deflect the high-velocity projectile to dismantle reinforced target blocks.
instructions: Angle paddle impacts to target high-tier bricks.
Collect descending enhancement modules.
Prevent projectile from breaching lower boundary.

title: Sub-Zero Pong
shortDesc: Two-terminal kinetic rally simulation. Deflect the accelerated projectile past opposing security buffer.
instructions: Maintain volley to escalate velocity index.
Angle returns to exploit defensive blindspots.
First terminal to achieve 7 victories wins.

title: Desert Sprint
shortDesc: Infinite perimeter reconnaissance. Traverse hostile terrain obstacles under escalating temporal acceleration.
instructions: Leap over environmental obstacles.
Slide beneath low-altitude aerial biped threats.
Survive day/night telemetry shifts.
